description: A clock divider, sending a trigger every so many ticks and again at an offset from those

params.text: Sets how many clock ticks pass between triggers, 1 to 64
Sets a second trigger a number of ticks after each division, 0 to 64

inputs.text: A trigger here sets the count back to the beginning

outputs.text: A trigger on each division and on each offset from one
The running count, as a voltage

menu: Blue, Orange, Yellow and Purple — set the colour the module is drawn in
Gate Length — sets how long the output triggers last, in milliseconds
